test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 6 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The book ‘Man Kautuhal’ was compiled by which of the following kings of Medieval India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Raja Mansingh Tomar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Man kutuhal was the name of a treatise created under the patronage of Raja Man Singh Tomar.**
 
• **Raja Mansingh Tomar of Gwalior **(1486-1516 AD) was the driving force behind introducing and consolidating Dhrupad. 
 
• He is also known to have related **Indian music** to the common and laymen by replacing many of the traditional Sanskrit songs with Hindi songs.
 
• Man Singh Tomar is credited with composing three volumes of songs **Vishnupadas** (songs in praise of lord Vishnu), Dhrupads, and Hori and Dhamar songs associated with Holi. 
 
• Mansingh’s support gave pride of place to both the **Hindu and Muslim musicians**. 
 
• **Man kutuhal** was the name of a treatise created under the patronage of Raja Man Singh Tomar.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Krishna II (reigned 878–914 CE) succeeded his famous father, Amoghavarsha I Nrupatunga, to the Rashtrakuta throne. Kannara was his Kannada name.
 
• **Parantaka Viranarayana** was the second son of Srimara Srivallabha. He reigned from AD 880 to 900. It was in his reign period that the Dalavaipuram plates were issued.
 
• **Rajashekhara Varman** was the second ruler of the Kulasekhara dynasty (later Chera Dynasty) who worshipped lord Shiva and became a Shaivite unlike his father Kulasekhara Alwar who was a Vaishnavite. He probably ruled from 820-844 A.D.
